title: Opposition rally against TikTok shutdown
location: Outside the Prime Minister’s Office, Tirana
scope: Single local demonstration called by the Democratic Party; appears to be one gathering, not a multi-city campaign.
organizer: Democratic Party of Albania; Sali Berisha called for the protest.
participants_original: Shqiptarja.com characterizes participation as minimal; it gives no number.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. The only opened post-event account says attendance was minimal but provides no count.

start_date.summary: Article dated 15 March 2025 describes the protest held that Saturday.

end_date.summary: The article says it ended in under 60 minutes on the reported date; no exact end time is given.

location.summary: Outside the Prime Minister’s Office in Tirana.

organizer.summary: Article identifies Sali Berisha and the opposition protest; JOQ pre-event report (S011) separately records the call.

demands.summary: The article identifies the TikTok shutdown as the protest issue; JOQ records the call as opposition to the shutdown and censorship.

participants_original.summary: The report characterizes the turnout as minimal without providing a head count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No numeric estimate; threshold remains unresolved.

protester_violence.summary: The article does not establish demonstrator violence.

state_response.summary: The article does not establish an event-specific response.

notes: The event itself and date are reported by Shqiptarja.com. JOQ’s pre-event announcement gives the scheduled time and state-policy issue but does not establish execution. AP S001 exact URL is blocked and is not used as evidence. The only post-event account calls turnout minimal without a numeric estimate. Do not infer a count from photographs or general descriptions.
open_questions: Can independent contemporary reporting establish attendance of at least 50?
Was any demonstrator violence, arrest, or police dispersal reported by an accessible independent source?
Was the gathering a separate episode from other opposition actions in March?
